newsitem.title: UK: Dtd Brent weakens to trade at April Brent -15 cts.
newsitem.headline: Dtd Brent weakens to trade at April Brent -15 cts.

text.p: Dated Brent weakened on Thursday as ample supply of late March North Sea crude found little interest from refiners suffering from poor product margins, traders said.
A Brent cargo due to load March 20-22 was sold by a Wall Street trader to a European oil major for April Brent less 15 cents a barrel, seven cents weaker than on Wednesday.
"The North Sea is looking pretty weak at the moment and there's no arbitrage -- it's not even close," said a trader.
